notes.title: An Update Regarding The Olivia Plush
notes.content:
Hello all, The Olivia plushies have finally made it to the United States and are undergoing customs clearance. Once they're free from customs, they will be transported to our American factory for finishing, quality assurance, and finally distribution.



Since the delivery date is drawing closer, we're requesting that those who need to change their address for delivery do so now. This can be done using this form.



Further updates on the plush can be found by subscribing to our Plush Updates mailing list, which can be found at the bottom of our FAQ page.



We would also like to thank everyone for their patience during this process and apologize for the difficulty in making it happen quickly as we had hoped. We're doing what we can to get the product in your hands as fast as possible.
- Fixed auto-forward sometimes not working when loading a save.

- Updated to Ren'Py 8.3.7.
- Added Portuguese (BR) translation.
- Improved Thai translation.
- Fixed mod menu warning booting the user out of the menu when clicking 'Ok'.
- Changed formatting for history menu to be more compact.
- Improved performance of shaking text, notably on Android.
- Fixed the drawing minigame in chapter 19D using the chapter 3 drawing instead of it's own when checking if the user is eligible to skip.
- Fixed Ren'Py Sync not syncing latest chapter drawings and what endings the user has gotten.
- Fixed persistent data not fully resetting when deleting it from the Ren'Py SDK.
- On Android, fixed regression where the drawing minigame icons would be offset.
- On Android, changed menu separator bar to be further out.
- On Android, increased UI text button size to be similar to Snoot Game.

BREAKING CHANGE: The shouting text tag has been redone and no longer uses {atl_heavy} or {atl}. Mods using it should now use the {sh} tag, otherwise they will crash.

notes.title: v1.7.1
notes.content:
Improved Swedish translation.
Fixed achievements not syncing with steam achievements.

- Updated to Ren'Py 8.3.4.
- Added Thai translation.
- Added normal Snoot dialogue box for modders, via the 'dialogue_ui_style' variable.
- Mods with no loadable scripts now have non-interactable toggle buttons and are no longer greyed out.
- Adjusted legacy mod entries to have the same spacing as regular mods.
- Pressing backspace will now hide the mod details pane in the mod menu, and show mod errors if there are any. On Android, a separate button will appear for this.
- Decreased spacing between mod buttons on PC.
- Hot-reloading the game will no longer play the splashscreen.
- Tweaked the size of a few menu strings to look better in non-english languages.
- Adjusted text in the Help menu to look better.
- In Ch. 3, fixed sprite of Olivia's tail slamming on the ground being offset.
- Fixed potential crashes with non-english language scripts.
- Fixed first-time setup not working correctly while "Skip splashscreen" is on in the Ren'Py SDK.
- Fixed volume sliders not loading defaults properly.
- Fixed 'NOMODS' mod loader file flag clearing the load order.
- Fixed new mod toggles sometimes being non-interactable.
- Fixed About menu being able to scroll horizontally.
- Fixed mod names falling back to their folder name instead of metadata name if there's no metadata translations when displaying an error in the mod menu.
- Fixed dialogue click-to-continue marker sometimes appearing on a new line by itself.
- Fixed Inco's phone darkening the background instantly when he brings it up.
- Fixed chapter select not hiding Inco's phone and unblurring the screen.
- Fixed various strings not being marked as translatable.
- Fixed Ending 4 playing the scrolling credits if playing from the chapter select.
- Fixed a few typos.
- On Android, visual overhaul of Inco's phone - He now holds it sideways, with tweaked text sizes for all elements.
- On Android, the mod menu now has a separate button for starting a mod, and tapping a mod entry only shows the mod details.
- On Android, fixed the options language selector being able to scroll horizontally.
- On Android, fixed the lean scene's UI's buttons not having an alternate action (This prevented the skip button's hold functionality from working).
- On Android, fixed names in the namebox not being the same relative height as on PC.
- On Android, fixed Ending 2 text being offset incorrectly.
- In the Demo, removed useless 'Fullbody' tab in the gallery.
- In the Demo, removed useless Achievements menu and associated popups.
- In the Demo, removed useless option to skip to new content.
- In the Demo, changed end-of-demo store buttons to be layed out horizontally and removed the bouncing animation.
- In the Demo, removed loading workshop mods and associated uploaders to prevent crashes from mods made for the full game.
- Minor codebase cleanup and improvement (With a few exceptions because of engine update jank).

notes.title: v1.6.2
notes.content:
Improved polish translation.
Implemented workaround for two characters inhabiting the namebox at the same time not displaying correctly in Russian.

Added full Russian translation.
Added Swedish translation.
Added internal English language so non-English mods can be easily translated.
Metro station background and Painting Destruction Pre-CG now have segmented text for translation purposes.
Optimized all language assets.
Adjust extended credits viewport to not extend past the screen.
Fix "Signatures (Complete Menu)" music not looping correctly.
Fix "Phone Library" in the extended credits not being translated in spanish.
Fixed even more instances of sprites suddenly shifting up.

Added the gallery.
 Added Polish translation.
 Moved drawings menu into the gallery.
 Added Elckarow, creator of the phone library, to the extended credits.
 Fixed a few frames of Mia not being fully colored in the Mia Chase animation.
 Fixed some instances of sprites suddenly shifting up for a second.
 Slightly improved Spanish translation.
 Fixed some option toggles only playing the 'On' sound in the preferences menu.
 Fixed a few images having slightly larger dimensions than intended
 Fixed the lean scene's UI's buttons not having an alternate action (This prevented the skip button's right-click functionality from working)
 Fixed default audio levels not being properly set on initial launch.

notes.title: v1.2.1
notes.content:
v1.2.1

- Added achievements.
- Added full-game Spanish translation.
- Fix numerous typos, grammatical errors, misspellings, punctuation, and capitalization throughout the script.
- Fix a line that lacked an Inco sayer in Ch. 14.5
- Remove a duplicate line in Ch. 15D.
- Correct a samey line in Ch. 1.
- Fix the last tail gift CG not showing in Ch. 19D.
- Most images that contain words are now segmented for easy translation.
- Added a new person to the 'Special Thanks' credits.
- Removed the old version of the track "Pale Morning (Anxious Ambience)" and replaced it's occurrence with the updated version.
- Renamed the internal track mus_foundout to mus_epilogue for better clarification.
- Removed a few unused assets.
- Improved mod compatibility with the save conversion on startup.
- Almost all image assets are now under a CC BY-SA license, with the rest being CC BY.
- Updated the tracks "Later, Gator (Credits A)", "Je suis un Homme (Credits B), "Friends and Family (Credits D)", "Muddy Wheelchair", and "Signatures (Complete Menu)" to their latest versions.
- Fix popping in the tracks "Closest (Credits C)" and "Je suis un Homme (Credits B)".
- Change the photo Inco sends to Olivia in Ch. 9 so it's actually according to the writing.
- The "Clear all" button in the drawing game is now undo-able.
- Clarified the Russian translation as only applying to the demo.
- Optimized all image assets with Oxipng.

- Android APK added

Users can swap to the "android" branch on Steam to obtain it from their files.

notes.title: v1.0.11
notes.content:
- Add code to prevent crashes when game cannot connect to Discord RPC
- Improve save compatibility between updates

Integrates v1.0.10 fixes we reverted:
- Fix spoilery, end of game content
- Chapter Select debug tool now permits player to see ending-exclusive content
- Fix OpenGL Related shader crashes

If you have any new problems with this update, please complain loudly on the steam forums or our email.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
v1.1.0

    Added Android port.
    Added Spanish translation.
    Made various changes to the script.
    Replaced title screen music.
    Replaced game icons with higher-res versions.
    Updated Damien's front yard background.
    Updated Damien's living room background.
    Added a calligraphy CG when Olivia draws Inco in chapter 2.
    Overhauled Olivia's sprites to be segmented.
    Fixed shading in the pool dunking animation.
    Lowered the default view of the metro animation.
    Various small choreo tweaks.
    Music changes after Inco sits back down with Olivia in Iadakan's class in chapter 3.
    Added an easel prop when Inco and Olivia paint together in chapter 4.
    Drawing Game QOL changes:
        Drawing buttons are now smaller on PC.
        Added Ctrl Z support.
        Included an additional hint to hide the UI.
        When rolling back to the drawing game, there will be a skip button to prevent re-submitting a drawing.
